waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: FileRow mounts ErrorExpansion only for an expanded row in the Error status, so no cleaned or unchanged row ever renders it.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: FileRow renders the pattern only when the error text is not null, and every failure path supplies one, so an empty pattern never appears.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: The pattern shows one error string for one row and has no count, so there is no singular or plural wording to test.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: Only one row is expanded at a time (expandedRowId), so the pattern never renders twice; a mixed batch is the file table's area story.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: ErrorExpansion codes no length cap or size limit, and the longest string it ever wraps is the long-detail scenario, so a boundary row would repeat it.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: A row in flight is Pending, Reading or Processing and cannot expand; the pattern appears only after a verdict, and its copy write settles at once.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: The pattern renders engine English text and the hardcoded English hint Click to copy, so no locale string reaches it and a locale adds no state of its own.

waivers.subject: ErrorExpansion
waivers.reason: One error string is the largest input the pattern takes; thousands of files stress the file table and the status bar, and long-detail already covers the string size.
